A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NBD-colchicine, which has been used to probe the structure of tubulin, is not a good probe for dehydrogenases.
NBD-colchicine (NBD-col) and NBD-colcemids bind to a common site of alcohol and aldehyde dehydrogenases.
NBD-colchicine is a good fluorescent probe for the colchicine binding sites of tubulin and alcohol dehydrogenases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
N-deacetyl N-methyl colchicine (colchicine) is a competitive inhibitor of alcohol dehydrogenease (ADH).
